title: ee.mesh.revoke_result.v1
description: Result envelope emitted by the SRR6.46.9 `ee mesh revoke <node-key> [--workspace .] [--reason "..."] [--dry-run] [--json]` command. Reports per-peer revocation without full disable: the peer removed from the materialized peer-group, the workspace-scoped denylist updated so the next auto-discovery pass does not re-include the peer, and the audit row recording the reason.

outcome.description: `revoked`: peer removed from group + denylist appended; `dry_run`: --dry-run requested, steps 1-3 ran (lock + resolve + audit row) but step 4 was skipped; `unknown_peer`: peer not in materialized group, emitted with the `mesh_revoke_unknown_peer` warning caution.

revokedNodeKey.description: The node-key passed as the positional argument. Always echoed back (even on unknown_peer outcomes) so the caller can pair the response with the request.

auditRowId.description: Id of the ee_audit row emitted with event_type=mesh.peer_revoked. Always present (even on dry-run + unknown_peer) so the audit log records every attempted revocation.

dryRun.description: True when the caller passed --dry-run. Step 4 (durable mutation) is skipped when true.

userReason.description: Verbatim --reason argument passed by the operator, stored on the audit row. Null when --reason was omitted.

remainingPeerCount.description: Count of peers remaining in the materialized peer-group after revocation. When outcome=unknown_peer this equals the pre-call count.

newPeerSetHash.description: Stable BLAKE3 hash of the sorted node-key set after revocation. Null when outcome=unknown_peer (no change). Pinned to blake3:<32-128 hex> so support bundles can compare peer-set identity without leaking node-keys.

denylistUpdated.description: True when the workspace-scoped `.ee/discovery_denylist.toml` was updated (revoked) OR would be under --dry-run; false for unknown_peer outcomes.

cautions.description: UX hazard signals the renderer surfaces visually. Closed set: `mesh_revoke_unknown_peer`, `mesh_revoke_last_peer_in_group`, `mesh_revoke_dry_run`. Severity is `info` or `warning` only.

nodeKey.description: Stable tailscale node identifier (e.g. `nodekey:<base64>`). Redactable under the `tailscale_metadata` class for support bundles.
